WITH net_lines AS (
    SELECT f.sale_date AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT d.fiscal_year, cs.region, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT n.store_id) AS stores
FROM net_lines n
JOIN dim_date d   ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = n.store_id AND cs.is_current
WHERE d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2026/27','FY2025/26') AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 1 AND 22
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1, 3 DESC

WITH params AS (
    SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS ty_year, 'FY2025/26' AS ly_year, 1 AS first_week, 22 AS last_week
),
range_start AS (
    SELECT MIN(d.calendar_date) AS first_day
    FROM dim_date d CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE d.fiscal_year = params.ty_year AND d.fiscal_week = params.first_week
),
weeks AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, d.fiscal_week_start_date, d.fiscal_week_end_date
    FROM dim_date d CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE d.fiscal_year IN (params.ty_year, params.ly_year)
      AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN params.first_week AND LEAST(params.last_week, 52)
),
store_weeks AS (
    SELECT st.store_id, w.fiscal_year, w.fiscal_week,
           (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= w.fiscal_week_start_date)
           AND (st.close_date IS NULL OR st.close_date >= w.fiscal_week_end_date)
           AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ref_store_closure c
                           WHERE c.store_id = st.store_id
                             AND c.closure_start_date <= w.fiscal_week_end_date
                             AND c.closure_end_date >= w.fiscal_week_start_date) AS trading
    FROM dim_store st
    CROSS JOIN weeks w
    WHERE st.is_current AND st.store_id < 900
),
lfl_store_weeks AS (
    SELECT ty.store_id, ty.fiscal_week
    FROM store_weeks ty
    CROSS JOIN params
    CROSS JOIN range_start
    JOIN store_weeks ly ON ly.store_id = ty.store_id AND ly.fiscal_week = ty.fiscal_week AND ly.fiscal_year = params.ly_year
    JOIN dim_store st   ON st.store_id = ty.store_id AND st.is_current
    WHERE ty.fiscal_year = params.ty_year AND ty.trading AND ly.trading
      AND (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= range_start.first_day - 364)
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT f.sale_date AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
lfl_sales AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_year, cs.region, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales,
           COUNT(DISTINCT n.store_id) AS stores
    FROM net_lines n
    JOIN dim_date d   ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
    JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = n.store_id AND cs.is_current
    JOIN lfl_store_weeks l ON l.store_id = n.store_id AND l.fiscal_week = d.fiscal_week
    CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE d.fiscal_year IN (params.ty_year, params.ly_year)
      AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN params.first_week AND LEAST(params.last_week, 52)
    GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, cs.region
)
SELECT RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ty.net_sales / ly.net_sales DESC) AS rank, ty.region, ty.stores,
       ty.net_sales AS this_year, ly.net_sales AS last_year,
       ROUND(100.0 * (ty.net_sales / ly.net_sales - 1), 2) AS lfl_growth_pct
FROM lfl_sales ty
CROSS JOIN params
JOIN lfl_sales ly ON ly.region = ty.region AND ly.fiscal_year = params.ly_year
WHERE ty.fiscal_year = params.ty_year
ORDER BY rank

WITH net_lines AS (
    SELECT f.sale_date AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
), mine AS (
  SELECT d.fiscal_year, SUM(n.net_sales) AS v FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=n.business_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2026/27','FY2025/26') AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 1 AND 22 GROUP BY 1
), ctl AS (
  SELECT d.fiscal_year, SUM(r.net_sales) AS c FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=r.business_date
  WHERE r.store_id < 900 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2026/27','FY2025/26') AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 1 AND 22 GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT mine.fiscal_year, v, c, v-c AS diff FROM mine JOIN ctl USING (fiscal_year)

WITH net_lines AS (
    SELECT f.sale_date AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
), mine AS (
  SELECT n.business_date, n.store_id, SUM(n.net_sales) AS v FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=n.business_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 1 AND 22 GROUP BY 1,2
), ctl AS (
  SELECT r.business_date, r.store_id, r.net_sales AS c FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=r.business_date
  WHERE r.store_id < 900 AND d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 1 AND 22
)
SELECT coalesce(mine.business_date, ctl.business_date) AS dt, coalesce(mine.store_id, ctl.store_id) AS store_id, v, c, coalesce(v,0)-coalesce(c,0) AS diff
FROM mine FULL JOIN ctl ON mine.business_date=ctl.business_date AND mine.store_id=ctl.store_id
WHERE abs(coalesce(v,0)-coalesce(c,0)) > 0.005
ORDER BY dt, store_id

WITH l AS (
  SELECT f.* FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
  WHERE s.store_id=116 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-09-15' AND DATE '2025-09-21'
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n_rows, COUNT(DISTINCT sales_line_id) AS n_ids, COUNT(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) AS n_receipt_lines,
       SUM(net_amount) AS net_all, MIN(etl_loaded_at) AS min_load, MAX(etl_loaded_at) AS max_load,
       COUNT(DISTINCT etl_loaded_at) AS n_loads,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT sales_line_id FROM l GROUP BY 1 HAVING COUNT(*)>1)) AS dup_ids
FROM l

WITH dups AS (
  SELECT receipt_id, line_no, COUNT(*) AS n, MIN(sales_line_id) AS id_a, MAX(sales_line_id) AS id_b,
         MIN(net_amount) AS min_net, MAX(net_amount) AS max_net, MIN(etl_loaded_at) AS load_a, MAX(etl_loaded_at) AS load_b,
         MIN(sale_date) AS d_min, MAX(sale_date) AS d_max, MIN(sale_ts_utc) AS t_min, MAX(sale_ts_utc) AS t_max
  FROM fact_sales_line GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING COUNT(*)>1
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS dup_groups, MIN(d_min) AS first_date, MAX(d_max) AS last_date, SUM(CASE WHEN min_net=max_net THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS same_net,
       SUM(CASE WHEN t_min=t_max THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS same_ts, MAX(n) AS max_n,
       SUM(CASE WHEN id_b-id_a=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS same_id,
       MIN(load_a) AS min_load_a, MAX(load_b) AS max_load_b
FROM dups
